tokens.description: AECPilot "Submit", MCP clients (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cline, Open WebUI…) and scripts connect with these access tokens using your permissions. An access token is shown only once, when it is created.

connector.heading: Run with My Own Claude/Cursor Subscription
connector.description: After creating a Read + Write token, run the connector in the repo folder. Cursor connects to your account through the browser on the first command; the Claude option uses the existing Claude Code session on your computer.

mcp.heading: Connect with MCP (other AI clients)
mcp.description: For Claude Code, use the command below; in other clients enter the same address and Authorization header as a "Streamable HTTP" server.

apps.heading: Connected Applications
apps.description: OpenCDE applications you approved (Solibri, BCF tools…) connect with your permissions. Removing access invalidates all of the application's access tokens; the application asks for approval again next time.
